lines.1: 「All right, Subaru. Explain what makes this game special so even I can understand it. I'll play the total idiot, so make sure I can still follow along.」
lines.2: 「So I can just treat you like usual?」
lines.4: 「Whoa, now that's seriously stupid. All right, lesson time, little crab. Raise your hand if you don't understand.」
lines.5: 「It's a dating sim. The goal is to get close to the girl you have your eye on.」
lines.6: 「Yoppi, our stagehand, slide the game screen over.」
lines.7: 「I told you not to call me Yoppi... Oof... there. Is this okay?」
lines.8: 「Thanks. Just check the map, choose the character whose route you want, and click on her. You'll lock into her story in no time.」
lines.9: 「You don't get many days on the map, so if you run around after too many girls, you'll blow it.」
lines.10: 「Once you're locked into a character's story, is it all one straight path?」
lines.11: 「Nope. Some routes can still branch into different endings. Choose your girl wisely--and your choices, too.」
lines.13: 「Yoppi doesn't show up at first either. Apparently you can unlock their routes by meeting certain conditions.」
lines.15: 「Easy. If you really can't figure them out, check the manual. It's all in there.」
lines.16: 「So, Professor Subaru, do you have a recommended route order?」
lines.17: 「Basically, it sounds like you're free to choose, but there's a note here, so I'll read it.」
lines.18: 「Let's see... Kinu Kanisawa's route is especially easy to get into, so start there. Then Otome or Erika would be good.」
lines.20: 「For things like keyboard settings, click this icon. You can change them here.」
lines.21: 「Whoa, there are a lot of things you can tweak.」
lines.22: 「You can control things like screen size and quick-save with a single keystroke. Don't forget.」
lines.24: 「If you want, try pressing the key assigned to it. I think it defaults to F5.」
lines.25: 「So if someone walks in, you use this to cover your tracks.」
lines.26: 「That's about it. Come back if you get confused.」
